ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p340/r3.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p340/r3.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p340/r3.claim: Kalla rebukes their demand for scriptures and shows the real reason for turning from the reminder: they do not fear the Hereafter.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p340/r3.anchor: كلا: ردع عن إرادتهم تلك وزجر لهم عن اقتراح الآيات، بل لا يخافون الآخرة

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p340/r4.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p340/r4.speaker: أبو حيوة
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p340/r4.claim: Abu Haywa reads the verb ‘fear’ in the second person, as a shift to direct address.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p340/r5.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p340/r5.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p340/r5.claim: Kalla also rebukes their neglect of the reminder; the verse calls itself a reminder, since tadhkira means remembrance.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p340/r5.anchor: كلا: ردع عن إعراضهم عن التذكرة، إنه تذكرة فمن شاء ذكره

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p340/r6.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p340/r6.speaker: نافع وسلام ويعقوب وأبو جعفر والأعمش وطلحة وعيسى والأعرج وأبو حيوة
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p340/r6.claim: Several readings vary whether the reminder and remembering verbs address the listener, use third person, or assimilate the letters.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p340/r6.anchor: وقرأ نافع وسلام ويعقوب: تذكرة بتاء الخطاب ساكنة الذال

NAHHAS:v5p74/r9.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v5p74/r9.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v5p74/r9.claim: The pronoun refers to the Qurʾan.
NAHHAS:v5p74/r9.anchor: 54 أي إن القرآن 56 قراءة نافع على تحويل المخاطبة

ALUSI-FULL:v29p134#5/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p134#5/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p134#5/r1.claim: Kallā rebukes their turning away from the reminder.

ALUSI-FULL:v29p134#5/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p134#5/r2.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p134#5/r2.claim: The pronoun may refer to the Qurʾān or to the preceding reminder, mentioned in the question about why they turn away from it.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p134#5/r2.anchor: إنه أي القرآن أو التذكرة السابقة في قوله تعالى فما لهم عن التذكرة معرضين

ALUSI-FULL:v29p134#5/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p134#5/r3.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p134#5/r3.claim: The pronoun is masculine because Qurʾān and dhikr are masculine; the phrase calls it a reminder of great consequence.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p134#5/r3.anchor: وذكر لأنه بمعنى القرآن أو الذكر تذكرة وأي تذكرة

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p275/r3.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p275/r3.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p275/r3.claim: The Qurʾān is a reminder and admonition.

BAYDAWI-FULL:74:50-56/r7.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:74:50-56/r7.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:74:50-56/r7.claim: The second kalla rebukes their turning away.

BAYDAWI-FULL:74:50-56/r8.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:74:50-56/r8.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:74:50-56/r8.claim: The Qurʾān is a powerful reminder.

BIQAI-FULL:v8p238/r7.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p238/r7.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p238/r7.claim: The Qur’an is a great admonition that demands following and adherence, so no one can claim there was no reminder or guide.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p238/r7.anchor: موضع وعظ عظيم يوجب إيجابا عظيما اتباعه وعدم الانفكاك عنه

DURR-FULL:v8p340/r4.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p340/r4.speaker: قتادة
DURR-FULL:v8p340/r4.claim: Qatada identifies the reminder as the Qur'an.
DURR-FULL:v8p340/r4.anchor: وفي قوله: {كلا إنها تذكرة} قال: هذا القرآن

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p332/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p332/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p332/r1.claim: A second kallā reinforces the rebuke: they will not receive individual scrolls; the Qur’an alone admonishes them.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p332/r1.anchor: لا يؤتون صحفا منشورة ولا يوزعون إلا بالقرآن

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p332/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p332/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p332/r2.claim: The statement that it is a reminder explains why their demand for scrolls is rejected; the pronoun refers to the Qur’an, and the indefinite noun magnifies it.

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p332/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p332/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p332/r3.claim: The response parallels the answer to those who demanded signs: the Qur’an being recited is sufficient as mercy and reminder for believers.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p332/r3.anchor: قل إنما الآيات عند الله وإنما أنا نذير مبين أو لم يكفهم

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p400/r5.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p400/r5.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p400/r5.claim: The repeated rebuke asserts that this entire statement, explanation, and exchange is a reminder.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p400/r5.anchor: ثم أعاد الرد والزجر بقوله تعالى: كلا وأخبر أن هذا القول والبيان

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p414/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p414/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p414/r1.claim: Here kalla means indeed or truly.

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p414/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p414/r2.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p414/r2.claim: An alternative view takes kalla to mean that matters are not as they wish and claim.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p414/r2.anchor: وقيل معنى كلا ليس الأمر كما يريدون ويقولون

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p414/r3.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p414/r3.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p414/r3.claim: The Quran is a reminder and an admonition.

JISHUMI:v10p7170/r11.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7170/r11.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7170/r11.claim: The pronoun in إنه تذكرة may refer to the Qurʾān.
JISHUMI:v10p7170/r11.anchor: إنه تذكرة الهاء كناية عن القرآن أو الوحي.

JISHUMI:v10p7170/r12.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7170/r12.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7170/r12.claim: Alternatively, the pronoun may refer to revelation.
JISHUMI:v10p7170/r12.anchor: إنه تذكرة الهاء كناية عن القرآن أو الوحي.

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p657#2/r18.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p657#2/r18.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p657#2/r18.claim: The Qur’an is a powerful and sufficient reminder, which itself rebukes their rejection of admonition.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p657#2/r18.anchor: ثم ردعهم عن إعراضهم عن التذكرة وقال : { إنه تذكرة } يعني تذكرة بليغة كافية

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p657#2/r20.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p657#2/r20.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p657#2/r20.claim: The pronouns in ‘it is a reminder’ and ‘remember it’ refer to al-tadhkira in 74:49; masculine forms reflect its sense as dhikr or Qur’an.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p657#2/r20.anchor: والضمير في { إنه } و { ذكره } للتذكرة في قوله { فما لهم عن التذكرة معرضين } ( المدثر : 49 ) وإنما ذكر لأنها في معنى الذكر أو القرآن

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p658/r3.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p658/r3.speaker: رسول الله
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p658/r3.claim: A report attributed to the Prophet promises ten good deeds for each person in Mecca who believed in Muhammad or disbelieved in him to whoever recites al-Muddaththir; no grading is stated.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p658/r3.anchor: من قرأ سورة المدثر أعطاه الله عشر حسنات بعدد من صدق بمحمد وكذب به بمكة

BURSEVI:v10p187#2/r7.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p187#2/r7.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p187#2/r7.claim: The second kalla is a rebuke for turning away from the reminder.

BURSEVI:v10p187#2/r8.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p187#2/r8.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p187#2/r8.claim: The pronoun in innahu and dhikrihi refers to tadhkira, synonymous with remembrance, or to the Quran, just as mawʿiza can mean admonition and sayha can mean sound.
BURSEVI:v10p187#2/r8.anchor: الضمير في إنه وفى ذكره للتذكرة لأنها بمعنى الذكر أو القرآن كالموعظة بمعنى الوعظ والصيحة بمعنى الصوت

BURSEVI:v10p187#2/r9.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p187#2/r9.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p187#2/r9.claim: The indefinite tadhkira magnifies it as a powerful, sufficient reminder; al-Burhan says it reminds people of truth and that the word was chosen for the rhyme ending.
BURSEVI:v10p187#2/r9.anchor: أي تذكرة فالتنوين للتعظيم أي تذكرة بليغة كافية وفي برهان القرآن أي تذكير للحق وعدل إليها للفاصلة

NASAFI-FULL:v4p298#13/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p298#13/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p298#13/r1.claim: “No indeed” rebukes their turning away from the reminder.

NASAFI-FULL:v4p298#13/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p298#13/r2.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p298#13/r2.claim: The Qurʾān is a powerful, sufficient reminder.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p298#13/r2.anchor: وقال ان القرآن تذكرة بليغة كافية

QURTUBI-FULL:74:54-56/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:74:54-56/r1.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:74:54-56/r1.claim: The Quran is an admonition, and whoever wishes may take heed from it.
QURTUBI-FULL:74:54-56/r1.anchor: أي حقا إن القرآن عظة. { فمن شآء ذكره } أي اتعظ به.

RAZI-FULL:v30p187#4/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p187#4/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p187#4/r1.claim: The rebuke addresses their turning away from the reminder.
RAZI-FULL:v30p187#4/r1.anchor: كلا } وهو ردع لهم عن إعراضهم عن التذكرة

RAZI-FULL:v30p187#4/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p187#4/r2.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p187#4/r2.claim: The Qur'an is a powerful, sufficient reminder; whoever wills may keep it before his eyes, and the benefit is his own.
RAZI-FULL:v30p187#4/r2.anchor: إنه تذكرة } يعني تذكرة بليغة كافية { فمن شاء ذكره } أي جعله نصب عينه

RAZI-FULL:v30p187#4/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p187#4/r3.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p187#4/r3.claim: The pronouns in “it is a reminder” and “remember it” refer to the reminder in the earlier passage; the feminine marker reflects the sense of remembrance or Qur'an.
RAZI-FULL:v30p187#4/r3.anchor: والضمير في { أنه } { * وذكره } للتذكرة في قوله : { الشافعين فما لهم عن التذكرة معرضين }

STUDYQURAN:74:53/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:74:53/r1.speaker: Q
STUDYQURAN:74:53/r1.claim: The emphatic particle kallā can also mean “truly” or “indeed,” a rendering that suits verse 54 better than verse 53.
STUDYQURAN:74:53/r1.anchor: In both verses nay, translating the emphatic particle kallā, could also be rendered “truly” or “indeed,” an alternative that fits v. 54 better than v. 53 (Q).

STUDYQURAN:74:53/r3.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:74:53/r3.speaker: Ṭ

STUDYQURAN:74:53/r4.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:74:53/r4.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:74:53/r4.claim: Revelation is a reminder rather than a list of demanded proofs: it reawakens knowledge of God and the covenant all humans carry in their primordial nature.
STUDYQURAN:74:53/r4.anchor: Rather, as a reminder, the revelation reawakens the knowledge of God and of the covenant with Him (see 7:172c) that all human beings bear in their primordial nature (30:30).

TAB-FULL:v23p462#2/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p462#2/r1.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v23p462#2/r1.claim: The Qurʾān is God's reminder to creation, contrary to the polytheists' claim that it is transmitted magic or human speech.
TAB-FULL:v23p462#2/r1.anchor: ذكرهم به. وبنحو الذي قلنا في ذلك

TAB-FULL:v23p462#2/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p462#2/r2.speaker: قتادة
TAB-FULL:v23p462#2/r2.claim: Qatāda glosses “it is a reminder” as referring to the Qurʾān.

TABATABAI:74:53-56/r1.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:74:53-56/r1.speaker: author
TABATABAI:74:53-56/r1.claim: This second rebuke refuses the demand for individual books: the Qur'an is a reminder and admonition, whose effect is the recompense prepared for the obedient and disobedient.
TABATABAI:74:53-56/r1.anchor: إن القرآن تذكرة وموعظة نعظهم به لا نريد به أزيد من ذلك

TABRISI:74:49-56/r13.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:74:49-56/r13.speaker: author
TABRISI:74:49-56/r13.claim: Kallā affirms that the Qurʾan is a reminder and admonition.

FARRA:v3p205/r10.author: al-Farrāʾ
FARRA:v3p205/r10.speaker: author
FARRA:v3p205/r10.claim: The pronoun refers to this Qur’an.
FARRA:v3p205/r10.anchor: وقوله: إنه تذكرة (54) . يعني هذا القرآن، ولو قيل: «إنها تذكرة » لكان صوابا، كما قال في عبس، فمن قال:

FARRA:v3p205/r11.author: al-Farrāʾ
FARRA:v3p205/r11.speaker: author
FARRA:v3p205/r11.claim: The feminine إنّها تذكرة is also grammatical, as in the feminine wording in Sūrat ʿAbasa.
FARRA:v3p205/r11.anchor: يعني هذا القرآن، ولو قيل: «إنها تذكرة » لكان صوابا، كما قال في عبس، فمن قال:

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p465/r3.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p465/r3.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p465/r3.anchor: {كلا} أي: حقا، {إنه}، يعني: القرآن، {تذكرة}، تذكير وموعظة

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p465/r4.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p465/r4.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p465/r4.claim: The pronoun refers to the Qur’an, a reminder and admonition.

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:74:49-56/r7.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:74:49-56/r7.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:74:49-56/r7.claim: The Quran is a reminder to creation, not sorcery.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:74:49-56/r7.anchor: كلا إنه تذكرة } إن القرآن تذكير للخلق، وليس بسحر.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:54/r1.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:54/r1.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:54/r1.claim: The reminder and warning referred to are the Qur'an's verses.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:54/r1.anchor: Öğüt ve uyarı olduğu belirtilen şey Kur’an âyetleridir.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:54/r4.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:54/r4.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:54/r4.claim: The verses present the Qur'an as God's warning, indicate no further book will be sent, and affirm its sufficiency for happiness in this world and the afterlife.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:54/r4.anchor: Âyetler uyarıcı olarak Kur’an’ın gönderildiğini ifade ettiği gibi başka kitap gönderilmeyeceğine, dünya ve âhiret mutluluğu için Kur’an’ın yeterli olduğuna da işaret etmektedir.

BURHAN:v1p65/r1.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v1p65/r1.speaker: author
BURHAN:v1p65/r1.claim: The Qur’an sometimes uses a feminine form where a masculine form would otherwise be expected in order to suit the verse ending, as in كلا إنه تذكرة.
BURHAN:v1p65/r1.anchor: الثامن تأنيث ما أصله أن يذكر كقوله تعالى
